scope: Actual M09 versus M10_FS020_r1 short-domain CGNS geometry. Read-only; no solver steps, no admission of a wave result.

method.bbox: Source-span polygons intersecting the band; unweighted cell percentiles plus full-polygon-area-weighted p95. Boxes are geometric extents, not directional face-normal spacings.
method.rays: Exact half-open line/polygon intersections. Crossed cells include partially intersected end cells. Grazing chords are not meaningful CFL length limits.
method.foil: Source-plane wall vertices sorted by rounded x,z; independent per-edge layer CSVs sorted by rounded centroid x,z and compared numerically.

notes: Diagnostic CellQuality < 0.01: 0.0 elements in fluid; review trigger, not universal acceptance limit
Diagnostic VolumeChange < 0.01: 2.0 elements in fluid; review trigger, not universal acceptance limit
Diagnostic SkewnessAngle > 80.0: 0.0 elements in fluid; review trigger, not universal acceptance limit
Directed sweep does not retain PrismLayerNumber metadata; audit layered topology separately.
Centroid y mismatch needs topology inspection before flow.

topology.method: CGNS connectivity: every volume cell must touch both span planes; prism coverage inferred by following consecutive quadrilateral cells normal to each foil edge, area weighted.

extrusion.method: Rebuild all spanwise faces and signed NFACE connectivity from unchanged valid source-plane polygons. Native target projection and its inconsistent pairings are discarded.

nominal.surface_and_outer_match: M08 surface, near-foil and free-surface controls; remote outer base changed
nominal.purpose: Coarsen remote domain only; protect middle region and preserve M08 foil/prisms/near-foil/FS targets.

notes: Diagnostic CellQuality < 0.01: 0.0 elements in fluid; review trigger, not universal acceptance limit
Diagnostic VolumeChange < 0.01: 2.0 elements in fluid; review trigger, not universal acceptance limit

topology.method: CGNS connectivity: every volume cell must touch both span planes; prism coverage inferred by following consecutive quadrilateral cells normal to each foil edge, area weighted.

extrusion.method: Rebuild all spanwise faces and signed NFACE connectivity from unchanged valid source-plane polygons. Native target projection and its inconsistent pairings are discarded.

nominal.purpose: Wave FS sensitivity: change only nominal free-surface control0.0285714to0.020m; preserve M09 foil/near-foil/prism/outer controls. Regenerated actual edges must be audited. Extend to matched4lambda domain after build; requires its own pairedcalm/wave, no accuracyclaim.

cost_interpretation.statement: Cell count rises by 31.40% on the unchanged short domain. This is not a measured runtime penalty. Smaller free-surface streamwise cells can also increase temporal-resolution cost; measure actual cost with matched solver settings and physical time.

extension_plan.vertical_rows: Carry the actual refined inlet/outlet z rows coherently into extension strips; do not restore old M09 vertical spacing.
extension_plan.distinction: The changed0.020m control is isotropic in the short-domain core, so it refines both x and z. Planned remote strips use approximately0.2m in x with inherited refined vertical rows. This is coupled free-surface refinement, not a vertical-only experiment.

limits: No accepted flow, calm or wave result exists for this new grid in this review.
Short-domain mesh audit does not validate the extended80m domain, wave propagation, boundary treatment, CFL or timestep.
An approximately H/20 guideline is not a universal acceptance criterion; compare measured wave amplitude,phase,mean level and force-cycle responses on matched grids.
Every regenerated wave grid needs its own matched calm reference; preserve M09 data separately.
A forthcoming extended mesh must be audited independently; do not assume the reported short-domain cell count or statistics apply to the complete wave domain.
